Nice — here’s the quick, no-mistakes flow for a rental-bike checkout.

# 1) Prep & ID

- Have ready: government ID, payment card, and the booking reference (if you have one).
- Arrive a few minutes early; docks can be busy at peak hours.

# 2) Unlock / Check Out

- **App users:** Open the rental app → “Unlock” / “Start ride” on your selected bike.
- **Kiosk / dock:** Tap your contactless card or insert your membership card on the kiosk, then select the bike number.
- **Card readers on bike:** Tap your contactless card or phone on the bike’s reader.
- You should get a clear “Unlocked” confirmation + a ride start time. If not, try again once; if it still fails, pick another bike.

# 3) Safety & Condition Check (60 seconds)

- Brakes work (squeeze both levers).
- Tires inflated, no major cuts.
- Chain moves, gears shift a couple clicks.
- Lights/reflectors present if riding after dark.
